response.sql: WITH timing_averages AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS group_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS baseline_avg FROM timing_averages) SELECT AVG(t.group_avg) AS mean_above_baseline, AVG(t.group_avg - b.baseline_avg) AS mean_excess FROM timing_averages AS t CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE t.group_avg > b.baseline_avg;
